# ThemeToggle

Light and dark theme switch.

`AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.ThemeToggle` · Surfaces

## Use

```jsx
<AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.ThemeToggle />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.ThemeToggle"></x-import>
```

## Notes

Light/dark switch: sets `data-theme` on <html>, persists the choice, defaults to the OS preference.

## Props (ThemeToggleProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | 36 / 44 / 52px. @default "md" |
| `variant` | `'secondary' \| 'ghost' \| 'onInk'` | @default "secondary" |
| `storageKey` | `string` | localStorage key. @default "cory-theme" |

_Also accepts: React.ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>._
